issue.title: sase-telegram test_launch_approval_uses_the_same_singleton_renderer fails: %id rejects session= keyword
issue.description:
In sase-telegram, `test_launch_approval_uses_the_same_singleton_renderer` fails on a
clean tree: the `%id` directive rejects the `session=` keyword the test passes. This is
xprompt directive fallout, not the gate-turn rename.

Proposed by sase-1ab.6 note #1 (the telegram cutover phase reproduced it identically on
the clean tree before its change). Find which sase change made `%id` reject `session=`,
then update the telegram test (or its fixture prompt) to the current `%id` contract.
Verify with `sase tool run check` in sase-telegram.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: The sase-1ab.6 phase reproduced it identically on the clean tree before its own change; the rejection is a deterministic directive-parse error.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by sase-1ab.6 note #1, which reproduced it on the clean telegram tree; not caused by the turn rename and not tracked elsewhere.
